target_host: 4 vCPU x86_64 @ 2.0 GHz (AVX2+FMA+F16C, no AVX-512, no VNNI)
workload: 34 frozen retrieval queries (22 replay + 12 disjoint) + 4 boundary edge queries, 512-D leading normalized slice
verdict_summary: Keep prod eg2-q8.gguf with existing flags. Every tested runtime tweak (--load-mode none, --no-repack, -fa off) regressed speed. Every lower-bit quant (Q6_K, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q5_K_M, UD-Q5_K_XL, Q4_K_M, UD-Q4_K_XL, Q4_0, Q5_0, IQ4_NL, and FFN-only mixes) failed the >= 0.9999 cosine / 34/34 exact top-5 parity bar (best quant UD-Q6_K_XL reached only 0.99857 min_cos and 21/34 top-5 parity at 0.90x-1.04x speed; fastest quant UD-Q4_K_XL reached 1.21x 1c / 1.44x 4c CPU speedup but dropped to 0.99142 min_cos, 8/34 top-5 parity, and lost 1 passage recall hit 8/34 vs 9/34).

cpu_repack_diagnosis.observed_behavior: On AVX2 Haswell without VNNI, Q8_0 and Q6_K/Q5_K do not use the CPU_REPACK heap buffer during prompt eval, so 6-bit/5-bit dequant overhead leaves Q6_K/Q5_K_M at 0.91x-0.98x of Q8_0. Only 4-bit families (Q4_K, Q4_0, IQ4_NL) trigger CPU_REPACK (61-69 MiB extra heap buffer), yielding ~1.15x-1.44x CPU speedup in multi-token query prompt eval while degrading 512-D vector cosine (0.978-0.995), top-5 exact parity (8/34-13/34), and passage recall (8/34 on Q4_K variants vs 9/34 baseline).
